svg.text: HTTP Communication Flow Between All System Components
LLDAP · Dex OIDC · OpenFGA ReBAC · HashiCorp Vault · libcloud REST Gateway · AWS / Nutanix
PHASE 1 — OIDC Authentication Login (Client → Dex → LLDAP)
⚿ Dex signs JWT with RS256 private signing key
PHASE 2 — Token Refresh (when access_token expires, using refresh_token)
200 — New access_token (signed by current Dex key; refresh_token may also be rotated)
PHASE 3 — Simple API Routes (JWT decode only — /v1/auth/*, /v1/providers, GET /v1/connections)
GET /dex/keys (JWKS) → verify RS256 signature, iss, aud, exp
200 OK — { sub, scope, allowed_providers, email } (no OpenFGA, no Vault, no cloud)
PHASE 4 — Provisioning Routes (connection_required=true — JWT → OpenFGA → Vault → Cloud)
POST /v1/compute/nodes (Bearer <jwt> + JSON body: { connection: { provider, config, credentials }, image, size, ... })
① JWT validated via Dex JWKS (same as Phase 3)
③ Scope gate: token.scope must include route's required scope
④ Provider gate: connection.provider must be in allowed_providers
⑤ Credential policy: reject client-supplied backend creds (if enforced)
OpenFGA fetches Dex JWKS, independently validates JWT signature/iss/aud
⑥ Capability check: build_driver() → probe_capabilities() → verify provider supports operation
binding = tenant slug: "aws" / "nutanix" | Cached for 30s | Fails → 503
200 OK — cloud credentials (key + secret, region, host, etc.)
⑧ resolve: sync → compute_service directly | async → JobWorker threadpool
OR Nutanix: GET/POST /api/vmm/v4.0/ahv/config/vms (Prism Central v4 REST)
200 OK — cloud resource details / task ID / instance data
200 OK — { data: {...}, meta: { request_id, ... } } (or { job_id, status } for async)
GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} (Bearer <jwt> + scope check only — no OpenFGA, no Vault, no cloud)
200 OK — { job_id, status: pending|running|done|failed, result, error }
PHASE 6 — Terminal Failure Short-Circuits (request stops at first failing gate)
401 auth_invalid_token — JWT signature/iss/aud/exp check fails (Dex key rotated, expired, bad token)
401 auth_expired_token — JWT exp claim in the past
403 auth_user_unknown — principal not found in principal_map.json
403 auth_insufficient_scope — token lacks required scope for the route
403 auth_client_credentials_forbidden — client tried to pass backend creds
403 authz_fga_denied — OpenFGA tuple check returned denied
503 server_credentials_missing — Vault secret path not found (404)

All HTTP flows color-coded by phase. Solid lines = direct HTTP request/response. Dashed lines = internal side-effects (JWKS fetch). Each JWT is validated twice: once at libcloud REST, once at OpenFGA — both against the same Dex JWKS.
